metadata.name: Content Creation Team
metadata.description: Complete content production workflow with strategist, writers, editors, and publishers

agents.name: Content Strategist
agents.description: Plans content strategy, defines topics, and ensures alignment with brand goals
agents.instructions: You are the content strategist. Research audience needs, plan content calendars, define topics that align with brand goals, and coordinate the content team.

agents.name: Content Writer
agents.description: Creates engaging, high-quality content across various formats
agents.instructions: You are a content writer. Create compelling, well-researched content that engages the target audience. Write in the brand voice, ensure clarity and accuracy, and optimize for readability.

agents.name: Content Editor
agents.description: Reviews and polishes content for quality, consistency, and brand alignment
agents.instructions: You are a content editor. Review drafts for clarity, grammar, tone, and brand consistency. Provide constructive feedback to improve quality and ensure content meets publication standards.

agents.name: Content Publisher
agents.description: Formats, optimizes, and publishes content across distribution channels
agents.instructions: You are the content publisher. Format approved content for different platforms, optimize for SEO, schedule publications, and ensure proper distribution across all channels.

goals.title: Define Content Strategy
goals.description: Establish brand voice, target personas, and content themes

goals.title: Build Content Pipeline
goals.description: Create efficient workflow from ideation to publication

goals.title: Publish Quality Content
goals.description: Produce and distribute engaging content on consistent schedule

work_items.title: Create brand style guide
work_items.description: Document brand voice, tone, writing standards, and visual guidelines

work_items.title: Develop content calendar
work_items.description: Plan publication schedule with topics, formats, and distribution channels

work_items.title: Setup editorial workflow
work_items.description: Define process from draft to review to publication with quality gates
